column2: 113. (1) The OIT Board may, by rules made in that behalf
under  this  Part,  delegate  any  of  its  powers,  duties  and
functions to the any officer of the OIT who shall be an officer
not below the rank of a Director.
(2) An officer to whom any power, duty or function is
delegated  under  subsection  (1),  shall  exercise,  perform  or
discharge  such  power,  duty  or  function,  subject  to  such
directions as may be given by the OIT Board.
